subject: ddl: let modify column with multiple indexes recreates index one by one (#62739)
summary: The change makes `newAddIndexTxnWorker` backfill only `reorgInfo.currElement` when `job.Type==ActionModifyColumn`, matching the modify-column reorg loop that iterates indexes one-by-one and preventing repeated backfill of all related indexes each round. Added a failpoint hook plus a unit test to assert the expected per-index backfill behavior for modify-column (including multi-column modify).
